Mayor Burnham and Canadian PM Carney Attend Everton Match

Mayor of Greater Manchester, Andy Burnham, attended a Carabao Cup football match alongside Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney. Both leaders were seen watching the game, which featured the team Everton. The event provided an opportunity for Burnham to celebrate with the Canadian Prime Minister.
